reconstruction_source: Epiphone Casino E230TD with two P90s
Shin-ei Psychedelic Machine reported by gear analysis
fuzz_outro_critical_audition.manufacturer_reference: Shin-ei describes internal effects as BC109 Fuzz, Tycobrahe-style Octave, Uni-Vibe
fuzz_outro_critical_audition.signal_priority: P90-like front end -> silicon fuzz -> genuinely overdriven low-watt Champ capture -> 6 kHz post low-pass -> sparse echo/room
routing_nonnegotiables: Fuzz before amplifier; do not post-amp place fuzz
Do not use a large pristine Two-Rock head as the primary amp
Do not turn on Octavia or Uni-Vibe merely because they are housed in reported Shin-ei unit
Use tonal A/B and match loudness within 0.5 dB before judging
If no Champ capture is present, pause exact-match claim and mark profile absent

alternate_b.starting_note: nonhistorical spectral fallback if heavy compressed texture missing; labeled approximation

alternate_c.starting_note: only if Champ unavailable; flag speaker/response mismatch

fuzz_outro_critical_audition.listener_test: Compare isolated outro reference level-matched to 10-second recorded Kemper DI reamp phrases (single notes, double stops, note-decay), rank attack rounding, midrange vowel, high-frequency rolloff, controlled feedback, decay shape
fuzz_outro_critical_audition.critical_uncertainty: Reported gear comes from fan documentation/gear analyses, not independently confirmed session stem list. Shin-ei model used does not establish which individual effects were enabled.

expression_pedal.assignment: only a pedal input explicitly configured as Wah Pedal
expression_pedal.note: A module may be compressor on a rig; only those Rigs with Wah loaded in a module will respond as wah

global_controls.switches: Per-Rig mappings in remote_buttons. I and II usually Klon/808, III special, IIII solo level, modulation or delay according to Rig.
global_controls.morph: Do not activate by default; leave selected Rig re-press morph behaviour at existing state unless requested
global_controls.noise_gate: Input Noise Gate 0 to low, particularly fuzz; do not lock input parameter across clean/fuzz without test
global_controls.monitoring: test with Kemper Kabinet and with direct headphone/recording output; do not confuse cab emulation output routing
global_controls.all_param_values: proposed initial targets; agent must map to live editable UI ranges; do not invent exact knob scale when type different

agent_instructions: Read connected device details and software/firmware versions. Build inventory of existing Performances 1-13 and amp source Rigs; do not write yet.
Backup all current profiler content and save screenshots. Any occupied desired destination 07..13 requires alternate unused slot selection or explicit approval to overwrite.
Search Sinewave pack using metadata tags: Sig/Lo/M/OD/G1265/M75, not fabricated exact Rig names; prefer Studio over Direct if using existing capture cabinet.

Find Fender Champ driven profile and Soldano SLO profile by source, rated dynamic accuracy, version and cab; if missing, search Rig Exchange, do not assert that arbitrary free files are authenticated.
Create each Performance and each slot per JSON, selecting a best-fit source Rig with captured drive amount. Preserve cabinet unless clear reason to substitute.
Load only documented Kemper effect types/presets. Enter initial state and approximate numeric target ranges; record actual UI setting after update. For empty effects use Type None.
For special filters, set Touch response in Wah Low Pass and confirm on-screen fields. For slicer set 1/8 Slicer at 84 BPM; it cannot reproduce full AdrenaLinn resonant sequencing by itself.
Assign upper Remote effects separately in each Rig, verify assignments and initial states persist after changing slots.
Configure any wah pedal to Wah only; do not overwrite a functional pedal configuration without backup.
Store all Performances in My Profiler, not only computer Local Library. Reboot or change Performances then inspect state after reload.
Record 10-second reference dry/lead reamp examples for each distinct amp family, keep loudness matched, adjust Rig Volume only for cross-bank normalization.
For Sob 12.4 conduct A/B fuzz procedure and archive primary plus alternatives as local Rig copies. Choose final based on measured spectral/attack similarity and ear, not brand/model assumption.

Deliver final ledger of exact original profile name, selected cabinet, full actual setting values, footswitch map and changed global settings for each rig. Flag any unverified tones and missing profiles.
acceptance_tests: 7 Performances at confirmed free destinations, with five named slots each; no accidental overwrite of any occupied location.
35 sound slots can be selected from Remote and recall exactly after changing bank and returning.
Sinewave pack profile tags match selected sounds; no non-existent capture filenames are asserted.
Every effect has a valid existing effect type and preset or is marked None/custom with UI verification.
Each Rig retains four switch assignments and intended initial effect states, with A/B/alternate modules per specification.
Mayer Sob 12.4 uses a driven Champ-family capture, fuzz before amp, EQ high cut, octave/vibe OFF initially, and separate alternate audition notes.
Wah pedal is calibrated; not unexpectedly changing volume; effects bypass at toe where needed.
No unintended source/library or system/global setting changes; all existing performances backed up.
All changes are auditable with before/after screenshots or setting export and profile list.
